name: example-mixed
description: A Remotion composition with a HyperFrames-made layer: the layer is pre-rendered to a video with alpha, then composited by Remotion.

scripts.site: npm run assets && npm run layer && node ../../packages/cloudflare-containers/bin/remotion-cloudflare.mjs sites create src/index.ts --site-name=site
scripts.studio: npm run assets && npm run layer && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.local: npm run site && node ../../packages/cloudflare-containers/bin/remotion-cloudflare.mjs render Mixed --local --engine=engine.ts --out=out/local.mp4
scripts.docker:build: npm run site && docker build --platform linux/amd64 -f Dockerfile -t rrh-mixed ../..
scripts.deploy: npm run site && node ../../packages/cloudflare-containers/bin/remotion-cloudflare.mjs services deploy
